manaNeeded: {4} plus enough mana to cast the extra turn spell each other turn
description:
Cast Time Stretch from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate Talon Gates of Madara by paying {4}, putting it from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Talon Gates of Madara enters the battlefield, it triggers, phasing out Hades.
Resolve Time Stretch, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Trench Behemoth by returning Talon Gates of Madara from the battlefield to your hand.
During your first extra turn, Hades phases in during your untap step.
Repeat during your second extra turn
